en.name: Freekeh
en.summary: Freekeh is durum wheat harvested green and fire-roasted, sold whole or cracked. Airtight, cool and dark it keeps 6–12 months, and about 1 year in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). No source publishes a freekeh figure — the cupboard number is read across from bulgur, the same crop treated a similar way, and the freezer number is our own extension of it.
en.pantry: Keep it airtight, cool and dark, where it runs 6–12 months. Freekeh arrives already smoky from the roasting, so smoke is not a sign of anything; what you are actually guarding against is the germ oil turning, and that reads as a flat, slightly bitter taste rather than as an obvious smell. Cracked freekeh has far more cut surface than whole grains and keeps less well, so buy cracked in smaller quantities and whole if you are stocking up. Away from the hob and out of the light, as with any whole-grain product.
en.fridge: No refrigerator timeline is published for freekeh, so none is given here. Cold does slow the germ oil from turning, and in a hot, humid kitchen an airtight jar in the fridge is a reasonable home for an opened bag — provided the seal is real and you let the jar warm up before opening it, so moisture condenses on the outside rather than on the grain. Cooked freekeh is a different food and needs the fridge in a covered container.
en.freezer: About 1 year at −18 °C (0 °F) in an airtight container, which is worth doing for a big bag and settles any question of weevils at the same time. That figure is our extension of the cupboard number rather than a published one, so treat it as quality guidance. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C. Cook it straight from frozen; there is no need to thaw a grain.
spoilage: A flat, slightly bitter taste in the cooked grain — usually the first sign, and it beats the smell.
A bitter or paint-like smell in the raw grain from rancid germ oil.
A musty or damp smell, or clumping in what should be loose grain.
Webbing, small moths or fine dust in the jar.
tips: Buy whole freekeh if you are stocking up and cracked only in small amounts.
Taste a spoonful of the cooked grain plain before dressing a salad with it.
Freeze a big bag on the day you buy it.
Do not let the smokiness mask staleness — it hides a flat grain surprisingly well.

faq.a: 6–12 months airtight in a cool, dark cupboard, or about 1 year at −18 °C (0 °F). Both figures are extrapolations rather than published limits.

faq.q: Does cracked freekeh keep as long as whole?
faq.a: No. Cracking exposes far more surface, so cracked freekeh stales faster. Buy it in smaller amounts.
Yes, about 1 year at −18 °C in an airtight container, and it deals with pantry insects too.

zh.name: 青麥仁
zh.summary: Freekeh 是趁青綠時採收、以火烘烤過的杜蘭小麥，有整粒和碎粒兩種。密封、陰涼、避光保存可放 6～12 個月，−18 °C 冷凍約 1 年。沒有來源公布過 freekeh 的數字——櫥櫃的數字是比照布格麥（同一種作物、處理方式相近）讀過來的，冷凍數字則是我們在此基礎上的延伸。
zh.pantry: 密封、陰涼、避光保存，可放 6～12 個月。Freekeh 因為烘烤本來就帶煙燻味，所以有煙味不代表任何事；真正要防的是胚芽油脂變質，而那表現為一種平淡、微苦的味道，而不是明顯的氣味。碎粒的斷面遠多於整粒，也更不耐放，所以碎粒少量買、要囤就囤整粒。和所有全穀製品一樣，遠離爐台、避免光照。
zh.fridge: Freekeh 沒有公布的冷藏期限，本頁也不給。低溫確實能延緩胚芽油脂變質，濕熱的廚房裡，開封後裝密封罐放冰箱是合理的做法——前提是真的密封，而且開封前先讓罐子回溫，讓水氣凝在外面而不是穀粒上。煮過的 freekeh 是另一種食物，要加蓋冷藏。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下密封容器約 1 年，大包裝很值得這樣做，也順便解決米蟲問題。這個數字是我們從櫥櫃數字延伸出來的，不是公布值，請當品質指引。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的。要煮直接從冷凍下鍋，穀物不必解凍。
spoilage: 煮好的麥粒吃起來平淡帶苦——通常這是最早的訊號，比氣味更早出現。
生的麥粒聞到胚芽油走油耗後的苦味或油漆味。
有潮霉味，或本該鬆散的麥粒結塊。
罐內出現絲網、小蛾或細粉屑。
tips: 要囤貨就買整粒，碎粒只買少量。
拌成沙拉之前，先單吃一口煮好的麥粒試味道。
大包裝買回來當天就冷凍。
別讓煙燻味掩蓋了老化——它掩飾平淡的能力強得出乎意料。

faq.a: 密封、陰涼避光的櫥櫃 6～12 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍約 1 年。兩個數字都是推估值，不是公布的上限。

faq.q: 碎粒和整粒一樣耐放嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。壓碎會露出大量斷面，碎粒走味更快，請少量買。
可以，−18 °C 下密封容器約 1 年，同時也解決櫥櫃害蟲的問題。
